scenes.headline: How a whole male fly nervous system was mapped
scenes.sub: One fly, 66 slabs, 44 person-years of proofreading
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Galangal! This is the first map of a whole male fruit fly nervous system. Here's how it was built.

scenes.text: For the first time, a male fly's brain and nerve cord are mapped together, in one animal, with the neck intact.
scenes.mark: brain and nerve cord are mapped together
scenes.say: What's new: brain and nerve cord mapped together, from one male. A circuit can now be followed from eye to leg.

scenes.title: From one fly to one graph

items.text: Cut the nervous system into slabs
items.say: The nervous system is dissected whole, then cut into sixty-six thin slabs.

items.text: Image it 8 nm at a time
items.say: Seven ion-beam microscopes shave and image them, eight nanometres at a time, for thirteen months.
Flood-filling networks grow each neuron from a seed point.
Other networks find forty-six million synapse sites.
Then twenty-nine proofreaders fix the mistakes: forty-four person-years.

left.title: Before: pieces of different flies
items: A male nerve cord, on its own
left.say: Before: a female brain here, a male nerve cord there, matched across animals.

right.title: Now: one male, whole CNS
items: Brain, optic lobes and nerve cord
Eye to leg is one query
right.say: Now: one male, brain and cord together.

steps.say: Song reaches the antenna, and detection neurons in the brain pick it up.
Descending neurons carry the command through the neck to song circuits in the cord.
Male-specific ascending neurons carry that activity back up.

steps.note: a loop only a brain-and-cord map can show
steps.say: A loop from singing to hearing, which only a brain-and-cord map can show.
The real data: brain in green, optic lobes in purple, nerve cord in blue, with images, traced neurons and synapses.

scenes.title: Where the 44 person-years went
scenes.note: backbone tracing, which makes the shapes, took 4%
scenes.say: Most of it went on small fragments: forty-one percent linking orphans. Tracing the big shapes took four.

scenes.label: of detected connections have a proofread neuron at both ends
scenes.note: 94% of presynapses and 42% of postsynapses sit on proofread neurons
scenes.say: Complete means every traceable neuron. About forty percent of detected connections have a proofread neuron at both ends; that's normal.

scenes.text: Machines image and trace; people make it complete: 44 person-years, 41% of them linking small fragments.
scenes.say: Machines image and trace. People make it complete.

recap: 40.1% of connections proofread at both ends
scenes.say: One fly, sixty-six slabs, a hundred and sixty-six thousand neurons, and an honest count of what's missing.
